description: Source file implementing fuzzing utilities for DNS resolution, including mock socket and resolver classes, and functions to generate fuzzed DNS configurations and addresses.

classes.name: FuzzedHostResolverProc
classes.description: Mock host resolver procedure that returns fuzzed address results, used for testing DNS resolution.

classes.name: FuzzedMdnsSocket
classes.description: Mock UDP socket for mDNS that generates fuzzed responses and errors.

classes.name: FuzzedMdnsSocketFactory
classes.description: Factory for creating multiple fuzzed mDNS sockets.

classes.name: FuzzedHostResolverManager
classes.description: Mock host resolver manager that provides fuzzed DNS resolution behavior.

methods.name: FuzzPort
methods.description: Generates a fuzzed non-zero port number.

methods.name: FuzzIPv4Address
methods.description: Generates a fuzzed IPv4 address, possibly invalid or reserved.

methods.name: FuzzIPv6Address
methods.description: Generates a fuzzed IPv6 address, possibly invalid or reserved.

methods.name: FuzzIPAddress
methods.description: Generates a fuzzed IP address, either IPv4 or IPv6.

methods.name: GetFuzzedDnsConfig
methods.description: Creates a fuzzed DNS configuration with random name servers, search domains, hosts, and options.
